scope: Configured Send Mail Review/Apply command routes, independent native tool retention and inherited file grants; actual patch-review and serial-import Git checks.

upstream_evidence.behavior: MENU_VIEWWITHMERGE invokes StartExtPatch with the selected patch and current directory. MENU_APPLY launches importpatch with selected rows serialized in original list order. Separate process launches permit tools to outlive Send Mail.

native_handoff.initial_failure: Fixture Base commit could not use intentionally empty mail-author environment. Fixture-local environment isolation corrected; no production change for this failure. First failure log preserved.
native_handoff.coverage: Actual hidden Send options, independent native WorkingTreePatch and ImportPatch controllers. Highlighted unchecked patch bytes/order; excluded unselected duplicate; inherited directory grant identity outside repository; source window close leaves children usable; busy review/import blocks Quit; real review Apply changes working file preserving HEAD/index; two real serial commits in order; own closes reduce retained window registry to zero. Actual configured Format callback installation. Existing View, options, notification, progress and private Git/SDK SMTP loopback/MIME checks also passed.

Import_regression.coverage: Existing full native receiver: real imports/signoff, conflict Abort/Skip/Resolved and close Cancel/Keep/Abort; hook stop; missing identity flow; patch editing/draft save/dirty close; unavailable Git session guards; app Quit recovery; preview styling/font/light-dark/whitespace/private clipboard; divider persistence; source handoffs and sparse-file preview guard.

checks.inventory: Pinned inventory regression passed; three rows remain partial with updated handoff scope.

Core_inherited.evidence: All Core/SMTP sources/resources, SwiftPM tests and Package.swift match full-suite manifest; both configurations Core/SMTP binaries match previous viewer checkpoint. No Core rerun for these app-only changes.

checks.cleanup: No matching receiver/app/compiler/SMTP/helper processes or current fixtures. Audit includes Import native receiver prefix and current parent cutoff. Three exact owned time-bounded UUID Send/Import QA suites were verified empty before deleting their empty plist files; private clipboards released. Native registry ended at zero.

limitations: No main app launch or ordered test windows. No physical menu/keyboard/rendering capture, external merge-tool selection, signed file-grant acceptance, Finder activation or App Store distribution. Complete mail-client/direct delivery, all dialog behavior, shared consumers, full documentation/site and application port remain unfinished.
